latestVersion.changelog:
SMBcrm Advanced Tools skill – initial release:

- Provides expert guidance for SMBcrm customers using advanced tools like Private Integration Tokens, API v2, workflows, custom webhooks, MCP, and Agent Studio API.
- Enforces use of SMBcrm-first terminology, secure implementation patterns, and API v2 only.
- Includes a detailed tool selection guide and solution-ordering workflow.
- Outlines required data models, authentication rules, and terminology for consistent, customer-safe results.
- Covers available API products and use cases for workflows, API integrations, and AI-driven automations.
